Added two grouping methods:
- **`groupRollbackRequestsBasedOnFileGroup(List<HoodieRollbackRequest>)`** — normalizes null `partitionPath` to `""`, keeps requests with `filesToBeDeleted` as separate base-file-only requests (never merged with log-only ones), merges log-only requests sharing the same `(partition, fileId, latestBaseInstant)` into one with combined `logBlocksToBeDeleted`, splits mixed requests into a base-file-only + log-only pair, and preserves empty requests so empty stats can still be collected.
- **`groupSerializableRollbackRequestsBasedOnFileGroup(List<SerializableHoodieRollbackRequest>)`** — same logic over the serializable variant.

## `MarkerBasedRollbackStrategy.java`
- `getRollbackRequests` now runs its mapped requests through `groupRollbackRequestsBasedOnFileGroup`, giving one request per log file (v≥8, log paths in `filesToBeDeleted`) and one consolidated request per file group (v<8, combined `logBlocksToBeDeleted`).
- `createRollbackRequestForAppend` (v≥8 branch) now returns the full log file path in `filesToBeDeleted` instead of `logBlocksToBeDeleted`.

- Added **`createLogFileMarker`** using `IOType.CREATE` for v≥8 and `IOType.APPEND` for older versions, returning the marker path.

- `withLogMarkerFile(partitionPath, fileId)` now delegates to `createLogFileMarker`.
- Added overloaded `withLogFile(partitionPath, fileId, instantTime, versions)`; the existing `withLogFile(partitionPath, fileId, versions)` delegates to it with `currentInstantTime`.
